trade: Proximity blending closes holes and makes creases ~16% worse (measured over 176 frames: holes 974px/30 blobs -> 287px/15 blobs, creases 31,316px -> 36,470px). A hole shows the background, a crease shows skin; the trade was accepted deliberately. Do not disable the blend to bring the crease count back down.
residual: Creases are not eliminated by this method. Removing them entirely needs one continuous mesh with a unified weight field, which changes the part structure and breaks per-part UI.

scope.excluded: head accessories; all longhair and face materials

evidenceBoundary: structural proximity blend; crease/hole pixel counts not measured here
